# #4736: Patch: follow-up to #4716 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #4716 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #4716 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45397719696)) found 2 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`f10180a05739`). `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #4716 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/audio/clockAlarm.ts:54`: In a hidden tab the alarm is often completely silent. The schedule only works if the Clock repaints about every 200 ms, but a hidden tab repaints at most once a second, so about a third of hidden-tab countdowns play no beat at all. That fails the acceptance item 'in a hidden tab the viewer's own turn clock and prompt countdown still beat'.
  Evidence: planClockAlarm only plays second s from a reading R with R in [s*1000 - CLOCK_ALARM_LATE_MS, s*1000 + CLOCK_ALARM_LOOKAHEAD_MS], which is [s*1000-250, s*1000+400] (constants.ts:120-122). That window is 650 ms wide, and the LOOKAHEAD constant's own comment says it assumes 'the Clock repaints every 200 ms'. Browsers throttle a hidden tab's setInterval(TICK_MS) (Clock.tsx) to at least 1 s, and Chrome's intensive throttling cuts that to once a minute after 5 minutes hidden. Worked example: readings at R = 12_500, 11_500, ... give top=floor(12_750/1000)=12 and bottom=ceil(12_100/1000)=13, so the loop never runs. The same holds for every reading whose phase (R mod 1000) is in (400, 750), so the whole countdown stays silent. The issue's proposal said 'Schedule defensively for throttled repaint', but the change leaves planClockAlarm and its constants alone. Every countdown() test steps at REPAINT_MS=200 or LOOKAHEAD-50, and none steps at 1000 ms. Fix: when the page is hidden, schedule far enough ahead to cover a 1 s gap, for example a named hidden-tab lookahead with LOOKAHEAD + LATE >= CLOCK_ALARM_BEAT_MS. The beats are timed on the AudioContext clock, which is not throttled. Add a countdown(start, 1000) test at several phases that expects all 30 beats exactly once.
- [ ] `apps/web/src/game/Clock.tsx:426`: The mulligan alarm keeps beating after the viewer has submitted their own mulligan. The viewer then hears up to 30 heartbeats and ticks, in a hidden tab too, for an answer only the opponent still owes. The issue wanted the opponent's side to stay silent.
  Evidence: The gate is only `readout.prompt.kind === "mulligan"`. readClock keeps the mulligan line armed for both seats 'answered or not' (R268), and match.tsx:478 sets `mulligan={inMulligan}` from `view.mulligan !== undefined`. The engine already sends `MulliganView.youReady` (view_for.rs:1874, wire/generated/MulliganView.ts), but nothing passes it to Clock, so a player who submits early and tabs away is beeped for the last 30 s of the opponent's decision. The issue gives the motivation as 'miss the mulligan and you keep your whole hand unpicked', and once you have answered there is nothing left to miss. Fix: pass the viewer's ready flag into Clock (for example `mulliganAnswered={view.mulligan?.youReady === true}`), gate the third useTurnClockAlarm call on it, and add a Clock.test.tsx case where the answered viewer hears nothing.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

# Plan

## Goal

Fix the two #4716 follow-ups where pointed: make the clock alarm beat in a hidden tab by scheduling with a named hidden-tab lookahead that covers a 1 s repaint gap, and silence the mulligan alarm for a viewer who already answered by gating it on `MulliganView.youReady`. Each finding is fixed where it points, with tests that fail without the fix.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/audio/constants.ts` | change | Add `CLOCK_ALARM_HIDDEN_LOOKAHEAD_MS` constant with comment |
| `apps/web/src/audio/clockAlarm.ts` | change | `ClockAlarmInput.hidden`, lookahead selection in `planClockAlarm`, `hidden` param on `stepClockAlarm` |
| `apps/web/src/audio/useTurnClockAlarm.ts` | change | Third `hidden` param on `useTurnClockAlarm`, forwarded to `stepClockAlarm` |
| `apps/web/src/game/Clock.tsx` | change | `ClockProps.mulliganAnswered`, per-render `hidden` flag, three hook calls, mulligan gate |
| `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx` | change | Pass `mulliganAnswered` into the `<Clock>` element |
| `apps/web/src/audio/clockAlarm.test.ts` | change | `countdown()` gains `hidden` param; new 1000 ms-step test |
| `apps/web/src/audio/constants.test.ts` | change | Pin the new constant in the R439 test |
| `apps/web/src/game/Clock.test.tsx` | change | New answered-viewer silent test in the R268 alarm suite |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, anything under `crates/` or `e2e/`, `spec/` (no new ruling note; see below), `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx` (it only renders the `turnClock` node), or `readClock` in `Clock.tsx`. No new `spec/rulings/` note: both fixes are client timing/audio gating, not a rules decision the spec leaves open.

## Steps

1. `apps/web/src/audio/constants.ts`: after `CLOCK_ALARM_LOOKAHEAD_MS` (line ~120), add `/** R506: a hidden tab repaints at most once a second, so a hidden reading schedules beats this far ahead; with CLOCK_ALARM_LATE_MS this covers one full CLOCK_ALARM_BEAT_MS. */ export const CLOCK_ALARM_HIDDEN_LOOKAHEAD_MS = 1_000;` (satisfies `HIDDEN_LOOKAHEAD + LATE >= BEAT`: 1000 + 250 >= 1000).
2. `apps/web/src/audio/clockAlarm.ts`: import the new constant. Extend `ClockAlarmInput` with `/** True while the page is hidden: schedule for a 1 s repaint gap. */ hidden?: boolean;`. In `planClockAlarm`, first line of the body: `const lookahead = input.hidden === true ? CLOCK_ALARM_HIDDEN_LOOKAHEAD_MS : CLOCK_ALARM_LOOKAHEAD_MS;` and use `lookahead` in place of `CLOCK_ALARM_LOOKAHEAD_MS` in both the reset line (`remainingMs > last * CLOCK_ALARM_BEAT_MS + lookahead`) and the `bottom` line. Leave `delayMs` as `Math.max(0, remainingMs - second * CLOCK_ALARM_BEAT_MS)` (up to 1000 ms ahead; the AudioContext clock is not throttled). Update the header comment to mention the hidden-tab schedule.
3. `apps/web/src/audio/clockAlarm.ts` `stepClockAlarm`: add sixth param `hidden: boolean = false` after `own`, and pass `hidden` through: `planClockAlarm(memory, { remainingMs, own, audible: alarmAudible(engine, settings), hidden })`. Keep the `{ alarm: true }` flag on `playSfx` unchanged.
4. `apps/web/src/audio/useTurnClockAlarm.ts`: change signature to `export function useTurnClockAlarm(remainingMs: number | null, own: boolean, hidden: boolean = false): void`, forward `hidden` to `stepClockAlarm`, and add it to the effect deps `[remainingMs, own, hidden]`.
5. `apps/web/src/game/Clock.tsx` `ClockProps`: add `/** R268: the viewer already submitted their mulligan answer; the shared countdown still renders but no longer beats. Absent means unanswered. */ mulliganAnswered?: boolean;`.
6. `apps/web/src/game/Clock.tsx` component body, before the three `useTurnClockAlarm` calls: add `const hidden = typeof document === "undefined" ? false : document.visibilityState === "hidden";`. Pass `hidden` as the third argument to all three calls (turn, prompt, mulligan). Change the mulligan gate from `mulliganRemaining !== null` to `mulliganRemaining !== null && props.mulliganAnswered !== true`. Update the R268 comment to say the gate is the armed mulligan prompt while the viewer still owes an answer. Do not change `readClock`.
7. `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, in the `turnClock={<Clock ... />}` element (beside `mulligan={inMulligan}`): add `mulliganAnswered={view.mulligan?.youReady === true}`.
8. `apps/web/src/audio/constants.test.ts`: import `CLOCK_ALARM_HIDDEN_LOOKAHEAD_MS`; in the `R439 pins the turn clock alarm's schedule` test add `expect(CLOCK_ALARM_HIDDEN_LOOKAHEAD_MS).toBe(1_000);` and `expect(CLOCK_ALARM_HIDDEN_LOOKAHEAD_MS + CLOCK_ALARM_LATE_MS).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(CLOCK_ALARM_BEAT_MS);`.
9. `apps/web/src/audio/clockAlarm.test.ts`: extend the helper to `function countdown(startMs: number, stepMs: number, audible = true, own = true, hidden = false)` passing `hidden` into `planClockAlarm`. Add `it("R506 a hidden tab stepping once a second still sounds every second exactly once", ...)` that for each phase of `[0, 150, 500, 600, 700, 800]` runs `countdown(30_000 + phase, 1_000, true, true, true)` and expects seconds `30..1` each exactly once with `atMs` equal to `startMs - second * CLOCK_ALARM_BEAT_MS`. Also assert the visible schedule is unchanged: `countdown(45_000, REPAINT_MS)` still yields 30 beats.
10. `apps/web/src/game/Clock.test.tsx`, in `describe("R268 — the viewer's mulligan countdown sounds the clock alarm")`: extend the local `mulliganProps(at, promptMs)` helper with an `over: Partial<ClockProps> = {}` param spread into `props({...})` (same pattern as the R4562000 suite's `promptProps`). Add `it("R268 the answered viewer hears no mulligan alarm while the countdown still renders", ...)` that renders `<Clock {...mulliganProps(at, 12_300, { mulliganAnswered: true })} />`, rerenders down through `[12_100, 11_900, 11_300]` plus a 200 ms loop over the whole 45 s window, expects `engine.beats` to equal `[]`, and expects `screen.getByTestId("prompt-clock")` to still have `data-kind` `mulligan`.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/audio/clockAlarm.test.ts`, `it("R506 a hidden tab stepping once a second still sounds every second exactly once")`: asserts all 30 beats exactly once at 1000 ms steps across six phases. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/audio/clockAlarm.test.ts`.
- `apps/web/src/audio/constants.test.ts`, extended `R439 pins the turn clock alarm's schedule`: asserts the new constant's value and the lookahead invariant. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/audio/constants.test.ts`.
- `apps/web/src/game/Clock.test.tsx`, `it("R268 the answered viewer hears no mulligan alarm while the countdown still renders")`: asserts silence plus a rendered mulligan line. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Clock.test.tsx`.
- Also run `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `cargo jackioh spec check` (new tests cite existing R-ids only).

## Done when

- [ ] Hidden-tab countdowns at 1000 ms steps beat all 30 seconds exactly once at every tested phase.
- [ ] The answered viewer hears no mulligan alarm; the unanswered viewer still hears all 30 beats; the rendered countdown is unchanged either way.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test` passes for the three files above, `typecheck` passes, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes, with no test skipped, ignored, or weakened.

## Risks

- Scheduling up to 1000 ms ahead changes `delayMs` on hidden tabs only; visible-tab timing is byte-identical (default `hidden = false`), so the existing `REPAINT_MS` tests guard it. The AudioContext clock is not throttled, so early-scheduled beats still land on time.
- `mulliganAnswered` is optional and defaults to beating, so existing `Clock` renders without the prop (all current tests) behave as before; `match.tsx` is the only caller passing it, sourced from the engine's existing `youReady` field, so no wire or contract change.
- `document` is undefined in SSR/jsdom; the `typeof document` guard keeps the `hidden` read from throwing, and the hook's try/catch already swallows audio failures.

## Open questions

None. Both fixes are fully specified by the issue's evidence and the code cited above.
